notes.title: Final Release!
notes.content:
Hi all, thank you for participating in the Cyber Lemur community! I wanted to let you know that Cyber Lemur is finally complete and is available for purchase. The final game includes 5 new levels that weren't in the early access version as well as some bug fixes. Please feel free to post any comments, questions or concerns about this version. I hope you enjoy the new content!

Cheers,
Brett

notes.title: Switching to Free to Play
notes.content:
Hello Cyber Lemur Community! 

I'm excited to announce that Cyber Lemur will become Free to Play on 7/8/2020! Cyber Lemur is still in development (Early Access), and I think that this will be the best way to encourage people to try the game before a polished paid version is released. In it's current state, I think that Cyber Lemur is worth a few dollars, but I don't want that to become a barrier to people playing the game, and I would rather have a rich community of players than earn a little money from a smaller number of players. Hope you enjoy the game!

Cheers,
Brett
